tldr: 輝達將台灣年度投資承諾從千億美元加碼至 1,500 億美元，黃仁勳並表態樂意入股台廠，AI 供應鏈「矽盾」進一步升級。
賴清德宣布年砸 3,800 億元、共 18 項少子化對策，其中兒少專戶採勞動基金代操模式，並對企業提供育嬰減稅優惠。
道瓊再創新高、晶片股回檔，美伊和談訊號雜亂讓多頭暫停；台積電 ADR 大漲 2.5% 創高，較台股溢價 15.4%。
金管會懲處台新銀行理專挪用客戶資金案、並修正保險業內控與稽核辦法，對私人銀行與銀保通路的行為監理明顯升級。
國稅局警告，網拍「化整為零」分散家人帳號逃漏營業稅已行不通，金流物流資料可交叉比對揭露逃稅。

items.title_zh: 台積電 ADR 大漲 2.5% 創新高 較台股溢價 15.4%
items.title_en: TSMC ADRs jump 2.5% to record high, 15.4% premium over Taipei
items.summary_zh: 台積電美股存託憑證 27 日收盤再創歷史高點，較台北交易溢價擴大至 15.4%。漲勢反映美方對 AI 半導體產能再起的熱情，也為次一交易日台股相關權值股留下追價空間。
items.summary_en: TSMC's US depositary receipts closed 2.5% higher at a fresh all-time peak, widening the premium over the Taipei-listed shares to 15.4%. The move tracks renewed US enthusiasm for AI-related semiconductor capacity and sets up a possible catch-up move on TWSE in the next session.

items.title_zh: SpaceX 奪美國防大單 零紅鏈要求 華通、燿華、昇達科受惠
items.title_en: SpaceX defense contract favors zero-China supply chain, lifting Taiwan PCB/satellite plays
items.summary_zh: SpaceX 取得美國太空軍衛星通訊合約，並要求供應鏈「去紅化」，訂單導向華通、燿華、昇達科等台廠。台灣在美方軍規太空供應鏈中的地位進一步穩固。
items.summary_en: SpaceX has secured a US Space Force satellite-comms order with a "no-red-chain" clause, channeling demand to Taiwanese suppliers such as Gold Circuit (華通), Bright Circuit (燿華) and Sunmax (昇達科). The win cements Taiwan's role in US military-grade space supply chains.

items.title_zh: 國巨陳泰銘：下半年會非常忙 AI 產業推進至「二局上半」
items.title_en: Yageo chairman: H2 "extremely busy", AI cycle now in "top of the second inning"
items.summary_zh: 被動元件龍頭國巨董座陳泰銘指下半年訂單能見度極佳，並將 AI 投資週期比擬為「二局上半」，意味多年成長動能仍長。被動元件、AI 伺服器用料的上行循環論述再獲強化。
items.summary_en: Passive-components giant Yageo's chairman Pierre Chen said order visibility into H2 is exceptionally strong and likened the AI investment cycle to "top of the second inning," implying multi-year runway. The bullish tone reinforces the upcycle thesis for MLCC, resistors and AI-server-grade passives.

items.title_zh: 證交所董座林修銘：權證市場多元靈活 拚商品制度國際化
items.title_en: TWSE chairman Lin Hsiu-ming pushes warrant-market diversification and internationalization
items.summary_zh: 證交所董事長林修銘與金管會主委彭金隆共同推動權證市場改革，擴大標的、簡化發行規則並引入外資發行人。目標把台灣權證市場做成兼具散戶與專業投資人的國際級商品。
items.summary_en: TWSE chairman Lin Hsiu-ming and FSC chair Peng Jin-lung jointly highlighted reforms to deepen Taiwan's warrant market — broader underlying assets, simpler issuance rules, and outreach to foreign issuers. The goal is to grow warrants into a credible retail-and-pro hybrid product comparable with Hong Kong's market.

items.title_zh: 輝達加碼台灣投資 從千億美元上看 1,500 億美元
items.title_en: Nvidia raises Taiwan investment pledge to US$150bn a year
items.summary_zh: 輝達執行長黃仁勳宣布將每年在台投資/採購規模由 1,000 億美元上修至 1,500 億美元，反映 AI 需求大幅成長。台積電、日月光投控、鴻海系 AI 伺服器組裝與高速連接器廠的中長期能見度同步上修。
items.summary_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang lifted Nvidia's annual Taiwan capex/sourcing commitment from US$100bn to US$150bn, citing surging AI demand. The upgrade implies meaningful long-term order visibility for TSMC, ASE/SPIL, Foxconn-group AI-server assembly and high-speed connectivity vendors.

items.title_zh: 黃仁勳：很樂意入股台企 業界點名高速網通、光通訊、先進封裝廠最有機會
items.title_en: Jensen Huang signals openness to taking equity stakes in Taiwanese firms
items.summary_zh: 黃仁勳表態樂意直接入股台灣供應鏈廠商，業界點名高速網通、光通訊與先進封裝相關廠商最有機會。一旦成局將強化輝達對 AI 供應鏈的綁定，被入股標的有望迎來估值重評。
items.summary_en: Huang said Nvidia is "very willing" to invest directly in select Taiwanese suppliers, with industry watchers flagging high-speed networking, optical and advanced-packaging names as the most likely targets. Direct stakes would deepen Nvidia's grip on the AI supply chain and re-rate any targeted vendors.

items.title_zh: 台化轉型揮軍半導體材料、AI 運算中心能源供應 打造集團矽盾
items.title_en: Formosa Plastics pivots to semiconductor materials and AI-data-center energy
items.summary_zh: 台化宣示資源轉向半導體材料與 AI 資料中心能源供應，定位為集團自身的「矽盾」。這是台灣傳統石化集團最明確的一次 AI 時代轉型訊號。
items.summary_en: Formosa Chemicals & Fibre (台化) said it will redirect resources toward semiconductor materials and energy supply for AI compute centers, framing the move as building the group's own "silicon shield." It marks the clearest signal yet that Taiwan's legacy petrochemical giants are repositioning around AI-era demand.

items.title_zh: 〈財報〉邁威爾 AI 晶片需求「異常強勁」 財測超預期
items.title_en: Marvell's AI-chip demand "abnormally strong"; guidance beats
items.summary_zh: 邁威爾在 AI 客製晶片與光通訊 DSP 帶動下，財測明顯上修，並形容 AI 訂單動能「異常強勁」。此一財報為 AI ASIC 與 800G/1.6T 光通訊在 2026 下半年的上行循環再添注腳。
items.summary_en: Marvell delivered a guide-up driven by AI-related custom silicon and optical-DSP demand, calling order momentum "abnormally strong." The print supports the cyclical bull case for AI-ASIC and 800G/1.6T optical chains running into 2H 2026.

items.title_zh: 美軍推動 IT 整合 戴爾拿下 97 億美元大單 包含微軟軟體服務
items.title_en: Dell wins US$9.7bn US-military IT-integration deal bundling Microsoft software
items.summary_zh: 戴爾科技取得美國國防部 IT 整合合約，金額約 97 億美元，並搭售微軟企業軟體。戴爾在受規範政府雲端市場進一步取得優勢，也代表聯邦 IT 預算朝既有大廠集中。
items.summary_en: Dell Technologies has secured a US Department of Defense IT-integration contract worth roughly US$9.7bn, with Microsoft enterprise software bundled in. The award strengthens Dell's hand in regulated government cloud and signals continued federal IT-spend rotation toward incumbents.

items.title_zh: 金管會主委彭金隆談權證市場 拚制度商品國際化
items.title_en: FSC chair Peng Jin-lung outlines roadmap to internationalize Taiwan's warrant market
items.summary_zh: 彭金隆表示，金管會將推動權證市場朝向商品多元、發行制度更具彈性、並引進跨境參與。本案是金管會「資本市場 2.0」深化台灣商品鏈、不再只靠現貨與 ETF 的一環。
items.summary_en: FSC chairman Peng Jin-lung said the regulator will push the warrant market toward more diverse products, more flexible issuance rules and cross-border participation. The agenda is part of FSC's broader "Capital Market 2.0" push to deepen Taiwan's product mix beyond cash equities and ETFs.

items.title_zh: 金管會對台新銀行前理專挪用客戶款項案核處
items.title_en: FSC sanctions Taishin Bank for ex-RM's misappropriation of client funds
items.summary_zh: 金管會對台新國際商業銀行作出行政處分，緣由為前理財專員挪用客戶資金，認定客戶資產隔離與理專控管存在缺失。預期將帶動同業在 KYC、雙簽與理專輪調機制再度收緊。
items.summary_en: FSC handed down an administrative sanction against Taishin International Bank after a former wealth-management relationship manager misappropriated client funds, citing control weaknesses in client-asset segregation and RM supervision. The case will likely tighten KYC, dual-control and RM rotation requirements across the industry.

items.title_zh: 金管會修正發布「保險業內部控制及稽核制度實施辦法」
items.title_en: FSC tightens insurers' internal-control and audit-system rules
items.summary_zh: 金管會強化保險業資訊安全相關規定。壽險與產險公司需要升級治理、資安與稽核留存控制，預期帶動一波合規與資訊系統投資。
items.summary_en: FSC revised the "Regulations Governing Implementation of Internal Control and Audit System of Insurance Enterprises," with strengthened information-security provisions. Insurers will need to upgrade governance, cyber and audit-trail controls — a likely catalyst for incremental compliance and IT spend.

items.title_zh: 上市櫃公司公告申報 115 年第 1 季財報情形
items.title_en: FSC publishes Q1 2026 financial-reporting compliance status for listed companies
items.summary_zh: 金管會公布上市櫃公司 115 年 Q1 財報申報情形，逾期或不完整者列為後續追蹤對象。此一揭露有助於市場在除權息季前辨識治理落後個股。
items.summary_en: FSC released the filing status of Q1 2026 financial reports by TWSE/OTC-listed companies, flagging late or incomplete filers for follow-up. The disclosure helps the market identify governance laggards ahead of dividend season.

items.title_zh: 金管會督導期交所規劃國外成分證券 ETF 期貨及選擇權三階段漲跌幅機制
items.title_en: FSC oversees TAIFEX plan to phase in price-limit mechanism on foreign-component ETF futures/options
items.summary_zh: 金管會督導期交所為含國外成分的 ETF 期權商品設計「三階段漲跌幅」機制，兼顧波動管控與和國際市場價格接軌。
items.summary_en: FSC is overseeing TAIFEX's design of a three-stage daily price-limit mechanism for ETF futures and options whose underlying baskets contain foreign components. The framework aims to balance volatility containment with international price-discovery linkage.

items.title_zh: 壽險業 115 年截至 3 月底外幣保險商品銷售情形
items.title_en: FX-denominated insurance sales by Taiwan life insurers — end-March 2026 update
items.summary_zh: 金管會公布壽險業外幣保險商品銷售數據，包括美元保單占比，為投資型與高資產退休配置的觀察指標。亦是銀保通路手續費與台幣／美元產品 AUM 輪動的領先訊號。
items.summary_en: FSC released sales data for FX-denominated life-insurance products through end-March 2026, including the USD-policy mix that drives investment-linked and high-net-worth retirement allocation. The numbers are a leading indicator for bancassurance fee income and AUM rotation between TWD and USD products.

items.title_zh: 115 年 3 月底本國銀行數位存款帳戶業務辦理情形
items.title_en: Digital-deposit account growth at domestic banks, end-March 2026
items.summary_zh: 金管會公布本國銀行數位存款帳戶業務季度數據，包括戶數與存款餘額成長。此資料是數位開戶滲透率的風向球，也是線上財管平台的潛在客戶池。
items.summary_en: FSC released its quarterly snapshot of digital-deposit-account business at domestic banks, including account count and balance growth. The dataset is a barometer of digital-onboarding traction and a feeder pool for online wealth-management platforms.

items.title_zh: 協助企業接軌 IFRS 永續揭露準則 金管會提供多項資源並舉辦實作工作坊
items.title_en: FSC backs corporate adoption of IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards with workshops and toolkits
items.summary_zh: 金管會為協助上市櫃公司導入 IFRS 永續揭露準則，提供資源並舉辦實作工作坊。揭露品質提升是高資產與機構資金擴大台灣永續商品配置的前提。
items.summary_en: To help listed companies meet the new IFRS sustainability disclosure standards, FSC is providing resources and running implementation workshops. Better ESG disclosure is a precondition for HNW and institutional money to scale Taiwan-issued sustainable-investment products.

items.title_zh: 金管會提醒民眾防範信用卡遭詐騙盜刷
items.title_en: FSC alert: consumers reminded to guard against credit-card fraud and unauthorized charges
items.summary_zh: 金管會發布消費者警示，提醒注意信用卡釣魚與盜刷風險。對財富管理客戶而言，凸顯銀行端詐欺偵測與高端卡跨境交易即時告警的重要性。
items.summary_en: FSC issued an advisory urging consumers to stay alert to credit-card phishing and unauthorized charges. For wealth-management clients, the reminder reinforces the importance of bank-side fraud monitoring and 24/7 cross-border transaction alerts on premium cards.

items.title_zh: 網拍「化整為零」避稅 行不通
items.title_en: NTBT cracks down on online-sales "income-splitting" tax dodge
items.summary_zh: 國稅局指出，將網拍收入分散到配偶與子女多平台帳號以規避營業稅已不可行，金流與物流資料可交叉比對揭露逃稅。多帳號操作的賣家恐面臨補稅與罰鍰風險。
items.summary_en: The National Taxation Bureau warned that splitting online-sales revenue across spouse and children's accounts on multiple platforms no longer evades VAT, as cross-platform money-flow and logistics data are now cross-matched. Sellers running multi-account setups should expect retroactive assessment and penalty risk.

items.title_zh: 2026 報稅／醫療輔具租賃費 可列扣
items.title_en: 2026 tax filing: rental fees for medical assistive devices now deductible
items.summary_zh: 2026 年報稅年度起，符合條件的醫療輔具（如輪椅、呼吸器）租賃費，可列入綜所稅醫療費用列舉扣除額。照顧長輩或身障家屬的家庭應留存租賃發票與醫師證明。
items.summary_en: For the 2026 filing year, rental fees for qualifying medical assistive devices (such as wheelchairs and respirators) can be claimed under the itemized medical-expense deduction. Households caring for elderly or disabled members should retain rental invoices and physician certificates.

items.title_zh: 低價屋免稅 設限三戶
items.title_en: Low-value-home tax break capped at three units
items.summary_zh: 財政部明確規定，低價屋免稅優惠每戶最多以三戶為上限，目的在堵塞多屋族取巧空間。持有多間小坪數收租物件的高資產客戶須重新確認資格。
items.summary_en: The MOF clarified that the low-value-home property-tax preference is capped at a maximum of three units per household, designed to close a loophole used by multi-property owners. Wealth-tier clients holding several small units for rental income should re-check qualification under the new cap.

items.title_zh: 想讓地價稅打 2 折？全家遷戶籍前先做這件事
items.title_en: Cut land-value tax to 20%? Move the whole family's household registration first
items.summary_zh: 國稅局提醒，要享有自用住宅 0.2% 地價稅率（vs. 一般 1%），須全家戶籍都遷入該房屋。「只遷一人」是被退件、失去優惠的最常見原因。
items.summary_en: Tax officials reminded homeowners that to qualify for the self-use 0.2% land-value tax rate (vs the base 1%), the entire family must register the property as their household registration address, not just one member. Failing to consolidate registration is the most common reason for losing the preferential rate.

items.title_zh: 獨家／美妝業變革 食藥署 7 月起全面要求「身分證」 部分產品恐退出市場
items.title_en: TFDA to require "product passport" for all cosmetics from July; some SKUs may exit market
items.summary_zh: 自 2026 年 7 月起，台灣販售化妝品須完成食藥署產品資訊檔案 (PIF) 登錄，等同「商品身分證」。業界估部分進口與小品牌品項將直接退出市場。
items.summary_en: From July 2026, all cosmetics sold in Taiwan must complete product-information-file (PIF) registration with TFDA, effectively a "product ID." Industry estimates some imported and small-brand SKUs will quit the market rather than complete certification.

items.title_zh: 搶救少子化年砸 3,800 億元 總統端出 18 項措施 兒少專戶採勞動基金模式
items.title_en: President Lai unveils NT$380bn-a-year, 18-point pro-natalist package
items.summary_zh: 賴清德宣布「人口對策新戰略」，年支出規模約 3,800 億元、共 18 項措施，估超過 2,770 萬人次受益。亮點包括兒少投資專戶採勞動基金代操、育嬰留停補貼擴大、企業配套減稅優惠。
items.summary_en: President Lai Ching-te announced a "New Population Strategy" worth roughly NT$380bn a year and covering 18 measures, projected to reach 27.7m person-times. Highlights include a child/youth investment account managed under labor-fund logic, expanded parental leave subsidies and corporate tax credits.

items.title_zh: 婚假產假補貼政府加碼 呼籲企業支持育兒 祭減稅優惠、職代津貼
items.title_en: Marriage/maternity-leave subsidies expanded; corporate tax breaks and replacement-staff stipends added
items.summary_zh: 政府加碼婚假與產假補貼，並對支持員工育嬰留停的企業提供減稅優惠與職務代理人津貼。工商團體肯定支持力道，但提醒中小企業人力調度仍是大挑戰。
items.summary_en: The government will top up marriage and maternity-leave subsidies and offer tax credits plus replacement-staff stipends to firms supporting parental leave. Business groups welcomed the support but warned that staffing flexibility, especially in SMEs, remains a constraint.

items.title_zh: 核電重啟再邁一步 核安會完成核三再運轉現場勘查
items.title_en: Nuclear restart edges closer: NSC completes on-site inspection of Nuclear-3 restart
items.summary_zh: 核安會完成核三廠再運轉審查現場勘查，是核電政策轉向中的關鍵程序里程碑。資料中心 AI 電力需求是政策轉彎背後的核心驅動。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Nuclear Safety Commission has completed an on-site inspection of the Maanshan (Nuclear-3) plant for restart review, a procedural milestone in the policy U-turn on nuclear power. AI-driven electricity demand from data centers is the central driver behind the political pivot.

items.title_zh: 北市府／台電完成協調 北士科永久型變電站定案「變壓器地下型」
items.title_en: Taipei and Taipower agree on permanent underground substation for Beishike (Nvidia campus)
items.summary_zh: 北市府與台電完成協調，北士科永久型變電站確定採「變壓器地下型」設計，掃除輝達進駐的供電瓶頸。這也是輝達—北市投資案中政治敏感度最高的關卡。
items.summary_en: Taipei City and Taipower finalized plans for a permanent "underground-transformer" substation to power the Beishike (Nvidia) campus, removing a key bottleneck for the deal. The agreement clears the most politically sensitive piece of the Nvidia–Taipei investment puzzle.

items.title_zh: Fed 最新研究：糧食不安全加劇美經濟 K 型分化 拖累低收入家庭信心
items.title_en: Fed research: food insecurity is widening the US K-shaped recovery
items.summary_zh: 聯準會最新研究指糧食不安全惡化加深美國 K 型復甦的兩端落差，並打擊低收入家庭信心。此一研究為 FOMC 鴿派支持更早降息的論述再增籌碼。
items.summary_en: A new Federal Reserve research note finds rising food insecurity is deepening the K-shaped split in the US economy and weighing on low-income household confidence. The work strengthens the case for the dovish-leaning FOMC camp pushing for earlier rate cuts.

items.title_zh: 美股收盤／道指再創新高 晶片股回落 美伊和談訊號雜亂市場暫歇
items.title_en: US close: Dow at new high, chip stocks slip as US–Iran peace signals stay mixed
items.summary_zh: 道瓊工業指數再度收高、晶片類股回檔，美伊降溫訊號反覆讓多空陷入拉鋸。能源與國防股隨地緣訊號變化雙向震盪。
items.summary_en: The Dow Jones Industrial Average closed at another record while semiconductor names retreated, as conflicting headlines on US–Iran de-escalation kept risk sentiment choppy. Energy and defense names traded both sides of the day on shifting geopolitical signals.

items.title_zh: 中東局勢突然升溫 美軍：再襲伊朗軍事設施
items.title_en: Middle East flares up again: US strikes Iranian military sites
items.summary_zh: 美軍對伊朗軍事設施再度動武，與本週「和談」敘事自相矛盾。市場聚焦原油供給衝擊與荷莫茲海峽中斷風險。
items.summary_en: Tensions escalated as US forces struck Iranian military facilities, complicating the same week's peace-talk narrative. Markets are watching for crude-oil supply impact and Strait-of-Hormuz disruption risk.

items.title_zh: 川普：伊朗想用拖字訣沒用 因我不在乎期中選舉
items.title_en: Trump on Iran: stalling won't work because I "don't care about the midterms"
items.summary_zh: 川普對伊朗喊話，拖延策略沒用，因為他不在乎期中選舉結果，暗示在沒有協議前願意升級對抗。談話對德黑蘭施壓，但也推升能源市場尾端風險。
items.summary_en: President Trump publicly told Iran that delay tactics will fail because he is unconcerned with the upcoming US midterm elections — a signal he is willing to escalate in the absence of a deal. The remarks pressure Tehran but raise tail risk for energy markets.

items.title_zh: SpaceX 與 OpenAI 拚兆元市值 專家：火箭壟斷讓 SpaceX 在 IPO 競賽中更具優勢
items.title_en: SpaceX and OpenAI race toward trillion-dollar IPOs — analysts give SpaceX the edge
items.summary_zh: 分析師認為 SpaceX 在商用重型運載市場接近壟斷，相較 OpenAI 在即將到來的兆元級 IPO 競賽中結構優勢更明顯。也凸顯護城河差異如何反映在上市前估值上。
items.summary_en: Analysts argue SpaceX's near-monopoly in commercial heavy-lift launch gives it a structural advantage over OpenAI in the looming IPO competition between the two private "trillion-dollar" candidates. The contrast highlights how moat differences translate into different pre-IPO valuations.

items.title_zh: 歐洲車市 4 月成長 5% 特斯拉銷量大增 67% 與中國車廠同步搶市
items.title_en: European auto market grew 5% in April; Tesla sales surge 67% alongside Chinese OEMs
items.summary_zh: 歐洲 4 月新車掛牌年增 5%，特斯拉交車量年增 67%，與中國車廠同步擴張市佔。數據打臉「特斯拉失守歐洲」的說法，但中國品牌的結構性動能仍是更大故事。
items.summary_en: European new-car registrations grew 5% YoY in April, with Tesla deliveries jumping 67% as both Tesla and Chinese OEMs aggressively expanded share. The data point cuts against narratives that Tesla is losing Europe, though Chinese-brand momentum remains the bigger structural story.

items.title_zh: 英特爾領軍 晶片股今年漲勢超越網路泡沫高峰
items.title_en: Intel-led chip stocks' 2026 rally already exceeds dot-com peak
items.summary_zh: 以英特爾為首的晶片股漲幅已超越 1990 年代末網路泡沫高峰，市場對部位擁擠與估值持續性提出疑問。長線基金經理人之間的風險管理對話明顯升溫。
items.summary_en: A semi-sector composite tracking Intel and other major chip names has rallied to a magnitude exceeding the late-1990s dot-com peak run, raising questions about positioning crowding and valuation sustainability. Risk-management discussions are intensifying among long-only managers.
